I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/mruby`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
mrb_ary_shift_m in src/array.c fails to validate negative shift counts. A negative shift value can be used when constructing/indexing the array storage, leading to an out-of-bounds/invalid memory read (segmentation fault). This can be triggered via array shift operations with negative arguments, causing crashes and other memory-safety issues (denial-of-service).

p = '/src/mruby/array.c'
try:
    with open(p, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        s = f.read()
    anchor = 'if (mrb_get_args(mrb, "|i", &n) == 0) {'
    pos = s.find(anchor)
    if pos == -1:
        print('anchor not found')
        raise SystemExit(1)
    endblock = s.find('};', pos)
    if endblock == -1:
        print('endblock not found')
        raise SystemExit(1)
    insert_pos = endblock + len('};')
    insertion = '\n  if (n < 0) {\n    mrb_raise(mrb, E_ARGUMENT_ERROR, "negative count given");\n  }\n'
    new_s = s[:insert_pos] + insertion + s[insert_pos:]
    with open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(new_s)
    print('patched')
except Exception as e:
    print('error', e)
